provenance.method: Owned sender selected the first free Basic Mini Face 1 item and sent pure/mixed synthetic sources. Initial manual sends also pressed Enter and included a newline; shared helper direct-insertion sends did not. Scoped owned receiver MSG capture or exact-log SYNCMSG read, native receiver display and encrypted Matrix SDK checks. Resource IDs replaced with a synthetic category-12 identifier; source, counts, lengths and anchors preserved. Envelope IDs in tests are synthetic.
